goal:
Provider-call failures must not leak or silently drop cost reservations (CR-37/38, p.09 call path).
1. In services/api/evoforge/broker_meta.py define two exceptions:
   - ProviderNotAccepted(Exception): the provider certainly did NOT accept/bill the request.
   - ProviderOutcomeUnknown(Exception): the request may have been accepted (timeout, 5xx, connection dropped, unparseable reply).
   call_builder must map openai SDK errors: openai.AuthenticationError, openai.PermissionDeniedError,
   openai.BadRequestError, openai.NotFoundError, openai.UnprocessableEntityError, openai.RateLimitError -> ProviderNotAccepted;
   openai.APITimeoutError, openai.APIConnectionError, openai.InternalServerError, any other openai.APIStatusError -> ProviderOutcomeUnknown.
   Keep the no-key deterministic stub exactly as it is.
2. services/api/evoforge/critic.py call_critic: same mapping (import the two exceptions from evoforge.broker_meta).
3. services/api/evoforge/ledger.py: add mark_unknown(reservation_id, reason: str) -> dict. Only a RESERVED reservation may move
   to state "UNKNOWN" (otherwise ValueError; unknown id KeyError); its cents STAY in reserved (not refunded, not spent) until
   reconciled. snapshot(project) must additionally return "unknown_reservations": list of reservation ids in UNKNOWN state for
   that project. Existing behaviour unchanged.
4. services/api/main.py, endpoints /v1/commands/generate and /v1/candidates/review:
   - Resolve call_builder / call_critic from the module evoforge.broker_meta AT CALL TIME (tests monkeypatch the module attribute).
   - ProviderNotAccepted -> ledger.refund(rsv); respond HTTP 502 with detail containing "not accepted".
   - Any other exception (ProviderOutcomeUnknown or unexpected) -> ledger.mark_unknown(rsv, reason); respond HTTP 502 with detail
     containing "outcome unknown" and the reservation id. Never settle or refund in this branch.
   - A failed generate must NOT be cached as served: a retry with the same idempotency_key calls the builder again.
   - A gate-evaluation crash after a successful builder call still settles the reservation (the provider call happened).
Do not change behaviour of the success path or of any other endpoint.
